cells.tense: The strength goes out and comes back, and here you sit with the pen.
cells.act: choose which star to steer by and steer
cells.ask: Name the heading your strength is for this season, in one flat sentence, with no case attached. Smaller choices drop out of it on their own.
cells.core:
You can tell what matters before any argument for it shows up. It arrives first; the reasoning comes later. That is what this place gives you, the ability to see what deserves attention without first earning the sight. Strength is moving out and returning, and you are inside that movement, giving from somewhere real and being filled by it instead of drained.

What this balance is free to feed next is heading, not effort. Several lights are in view, each genuinely good, which is why none of them gets the whole of you. Pick the land your strength is for this season and say it in a sentence with nothing argued. The other lights do not go out. They wait unclaimed, and the pull grows stronger once it has a name to answer to.
cells.sheetLine: Pick the land, and let the smaller choices fall.

cells.tense: You will be braced for a debt nobody has asked you to pay.
cells.act: keep your own count of what is owed, and pay it
cells.ask: Settle one small thing you feel you owe, quietly, this week. Then close the count for good and let the next need reach you without an entry.
cells.core:
Fairness has started running past the moment. Who will come up short, what you will have to make up later, whose share will land wrong — the reckoning visits rooms where nothing has happened yet, and your strength gets spent on the ledger rather than on people. Those who receive from you do not feel strength arriving. They feel themselves being weighed.

Bring it back to the single case at hand. There is a small thing you feel you owe someone — tiny, maybe old, maybe not even theirs to remember. Settle it quietly, one payment, no announcement. Then close the count and let the next need reach you without an entry. Strength that contains rather than crushes is strength not checking the balance first.
cells.sheetLine: Settle the one debt, then stop counting.

cells.tense: You are at a door you already walked through, pen still in hand.
cells.act: engage the hard part on purpose and see what holds
cells.ask: Take something you have been carrying purely out of loyalty and give it a real attempt this week, enough to learn whether it still holds you.
cells.core:
The strength is still in you. It travels outward and does not come back, and no one seems to receive it as a gift anymore. Holding things up is what you do well, and there has been nothing on the far side of it. Whatever you have been keeping steady, you have kept steady alone, and the out-surge has gone one direction so long it no longer registers as generosity.

So test one of them. Choose something you carry out of loyalty or habit and put a real attempt behind it this week — enough that it either holds or it does not, and you will be able to tell which. If it holds, the strength returns into it. If it does not, you can set it down and meet what is actually here. The attempt is what answers. Nothing short of it will.
cells.sheetLine: Test the old thing. Learn whether it holds.

cells.tense: You are moving toward something particular and calling it keeping busy.
cells.act: decide the heading from what you want, not from logic
cells.ask: Next time the question comes, describe where this is going instead of how it has gone. No supporting record in the sentence.
cells.core:
A direction runs under your strength that anyone near you can name. Asked what you are working toward, you describe what you have been managing — the shape of recent months, the thing that ran into the thing. The heading is real and already doing its work through you. Your answers leave the heading out, and the people close enough to ask can hear the gap, which is why they keep asking.

State the direction before your own accounting has earned it for you. Next time the question comes, describe where this is going instead of how it has gone, and stand behind that without support. The record does not need to ride in the sentence. Saying what you are actually steering toward is nothing more than the plain fact of it.
